description: Defines the VaapiVideoDecoderDelegate class, which manages VA-API video decoding, protected sessions, and encryption handling within Chromium's media GPU component.

classes.name: VaapiVideoDecoderDelegate
classes.description: Manages VA-API video decoding sessions, including protected content handling and encryption configuration.

methods.name: VaapiVideoDecoderDelegate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the delegate with decoding surface handler, VA-API wrapper, callback, CDM context, and encryption scheme.

methods.name: set_vaapi_wrapper
methods.description: Sets or updates the VA-API wrapper used by the delegate.

methods.name: OnVAContextDestructionSoon
methods.description: Handles cleanup or state update when VA context is about to be destroyed.

methods.name: HasInitiatedProtectedRecovery
methods.description: Checks if protected session recovery has been initiated.

methods.name: SetDecryptConfig
methods.description: Sets the current decryption configuration for the stream, returning true if compatible.

methods.name: SetupDecryptDecode
methods.description: Prepares a protected session for decoding, filling crypto parameters if setup is successful.

methods.name: IsEncryptedSession
methods.description: Returns true if the current session handles encrypted content.

methods.name: IsTranscrypted
methods.description: Returns true if handling transcrypted content, specific to AMD platforms.

methods.name: NeedsProtectedSessionRecovery
methods.description: Checks if recovery from protected session loss is needed after a decoding failure.

methods.name: ProtectedDecodedSucceeded
methods.description: Indicates successful decoding of protected video, resetting recovery state.

methods.name: GetDecryptKeyId
methods.description: Retrieves the key ID from the current decryption configuration.
